# Configuration and Device Tree

## Global Config (`medsdk-config.yaml`)

    platform:
      safety_mode: strict
      realtime: enabled
      thermal_profile: active
      network:
        dns: [1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8]
        proxy: null
      ai:
        runtime: auto
        fallback: cpu
        pccp: shadow_mode

## Device Tree Overlay

* Generated by `meddtc`
* Applied via `configfs` or bootloader
* Validated against hardware inventory on boot

## Runtime Overrides

    medsdk-cli set --key platform.thermal_profile --value passive
    medsdk-cli reload --module realtime_media
